achievements.name: Press [BOOM] to Defuse
achievements.description: Blow up 3 tripwires with explosives.

achievements.name: Ashes to Ashes
achievements.description: Burn 4 enemies with a single molotov.

achievements.name: Hang Time
achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies while you are on a ladder.

achievements.name: Long Way Down
achievements.description: Crash a helicopter by shooting the pilot.

achievements.name: Wild Fire
achievements.description: Take down a flying helicopter with a molotov.

achievements.name: Good Effect on Target
achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a direct hit from a smoke grenade.

achievements.name: Out of the Fire
achievements.description: Complete every single player mission on Veteran or Realism difficulty.

achievements.name: Tea Time
achievements.description: Finish single player on any difficulty.

achievements.name: Nothing but Net
achievements.description: Neutralize the 'Fog of War' machine gun with a frag grenade.

achievements.name: Trigger Discipline
achievements.description: Do not injure any civilians in 'Piccadilly'.

achievements.name: Play Dead
achievements.description: Kill all the enemies in the 'Embedded' field of dead bodies.

achievements.name: Companion Block
achievements.description: Only use one cinder block and bring it to the end of 'Embedded'.

achievements.name: Wall Hax
achievements.description: Save Alpha 3-2 from being downed.

achievements.name: Golden Path
achievements.description: Complete 'Clean House' without being hit using one bullet per threat.

achievements.name: Love from Above
achievements.description: Destroy 4 trucks with 4 drone strikes before they reach the end of their path in 'The Embassy'.

achievements.name: Pit Stop
achievements.description: Stop three APCs with Hadir's sniper rifle.

achievements.name: Driver's Ed
achievements.description: Shoot the driver of the suicide truck.

achievements.name: Two Birds
achievements.description: Kill both soldiers with one shot in 'Hometown'.

achievements.name: Tunnel Rat
achievements.description: Complete 'The Wolf's Den' tunnels using only the 1911.

achievements.name: Dodged a Bullet
achievements.description: Never get hit by the sniper while escaping captivity.

achievements.name: Got Something on Your Face
achievements.description: Spit on Barkov.

achievements.name: Hot Swap
achievements.description: Get at least one kill with eight different weapons when completing 'Old Comrades'.

achievements.name: Lights Out
achievements.description: Shut off the power to 4 buildings in 'Going Dark'.

achievements.name: We Own the Night
achievements.description: Kill all enemies at the Church, Clocktower, and Pool without anyone calling for backup.

achievements.name: Warheads on Foreheads
achievements.description: Reach Barkov's lab entrance using only drone strikes.

achievements.name: Circus Tour
achievements.description: Kill at least one enemy while inside The Reading Place, Aural Chic, and both Subway undergrounds.

achievements.name: Liberation
achievements.description: Complete all Special Operations missions.
